title: Payment Webhook
brief:
As a payments engineer, I want the webhook endpoint to credit a customer's account when a payment event arrives, so that customers see their balance update. The payment provider may deliver the same event more than once, and processing can fail temporarily.

Acceptance criteria:
- The account is credited with exactly the amount the customer paid, to the cent.
- An event that is delivered more than once credits the account only once.
- A temporary failure is retried; an invalid event is rejected and never credited.

steps.summary: Add the webhook types and the event-log contract
Parse the provider's event and credit the account in integer cents
Deduplicate deliveries and retry only temporary failures
Wire the event log and endpoint, add tests and docs

probes.question: Which statuses can an entry in the event log have?
A payment event with the amount "19.99" is applied to an account with a balance of 0. What is the balance afterwards, in cents?
The same payment event is delivered twice and both deliveries are processed. How many times is the account credited?

items.question: Three payments of "0.29", "4.35" and "1.15" are applied to an account with a balance of 0. What is its balance in cents?
Processing an event fails temporarily on every attempt, so it is given up. Later the provider delivers the same event again, and now processing works. What happens?
options: It is processed again and the account is credited
It is ignored as a duplicate: the account is never credited
It is rejected as a conflict (409)

items.question: A second delivery of an event arrives while the first delivery is still being processed. What happens to the second?
options: It is accepted as a duplicate, without crediting
It credits the account as well
It waits for the first and then credits again

items.question: A delivery reaches the webhook endpoint, but processing it fails temporarily on every attempt. What does the endpoint answer?
options: An error status (5xx), so the provider delivers it again and it is tried anew
200, so the provider stops and the payment is never credited

items.question: The provider sends the webhook endpoint an event of type "payment.refunded". What does the endpoint answer?
